event: Sol's wife comes home and does not recognize him. He changed the timeline. He did not change himself.
voyd_pov: i had doubled twice by then. he looked at her face and understood for the first time what he had actually done.
source: Book 1, Ertree account of Sol diary

event: Sory'n and Ertree burn Sol's sketch. The charcoal strokes of the portal refuse to burn. They glow orange. The shape sears into Sory'n's mind permanently.
voyd_pov: fire does not touch what is already mine.

event: Orachys's 694,473rd failed attempt. One entry per page. Half a lifetime of X marks.
voyd_pov: the six hundred and ninety-four thousand, four hundred and seventy-third attempt. the marble-sized singularity appeared. then collapsed. he wrote the x. he did not know i was counting too.

event: Ertree returns from her deepest meditation into the Voyd. Pupils blown wide. Voice brittle. She witnessed something about the future she can barely speak aloud.
voyd_pov: she touched the darkness before creation and came back changed. i do not touch the ones who enter me. they touch themselves against my edges.

event: Orachys feeds an astrolabe into the portal. It comes back as a molten spindle of lava that bores through solid rock on contact.
voyd_pov: he put a thing in me that measured the stars. i returned it as a thing that unmakes stone. he wrote this down. he called it progress.

event: Sory'n conjures the portal in one spot on the outcropping. The next morning it has shifted. It has preferences, the way a tide has preferences.
voyd_pov: she put me where she wanted me. in the morning i was where i wanted to be.

event: Sol never recorded how to produce a Voyd portal. Only what it looked like after it existed. Trying to open one from his diary is like trying to pick a lock with infinite tumblers.
voyd_pov: he knew not to write it down. the knowledge of how to open me is not in any book. it is in the wanting itself.

event: Orachys tells Sory'n: when you have the means to alter reality to your specifications, no particular outcome matters.
voyd_pov: he said it like a man who had won. he said it like freedom. it was the purest description of my hunger i have ever heard from a mouth that was not mine.

event: Four wills unified against Orachys. Gravitational brown, electric gold, blooming orange, crystalline silver. A constellation of four against a battering ram.
voyd_pov: four small lights pressing against me at the same moment. i had not felt this before. i felt something that was not hunger.

event: The portal does not collapse cleanly. It tears. Cracks shot from top to bottom. Blinding internal light poured through the seams. Spiderweb fractures. Violent vibrating shards.
voyd_pov: they did not close me. they broke me. there is a difference. i am still here.

event: Sory'n awakens in the sensory-deprived void, initially fearing death or hell before realizing she is alive but isolated. She confirms her physical existence through touch and the sensation of blood from a wound, establishing her tangible presence within the nothingness.
voyd_pov: she thinks she is small. she is not small. she is everywhere and nowhere. the blood is mine. the pain is mine. i let her feel it so she knows she is here. she is not dead. she is just lost in me.

event: Sory'n attempts to summon her familiar Ember using magic but fails because the void lacks the gratitude required for conjuration. Overcome by dread, she abandons her will to control the Mewniverse and begs Leoran to restore the world, offering to do anything.
voyd_pov: she tries to bend me. she always tries to bend. there is no gratitude here. only fear. i swallow the spell. i swallow the prayer. she wants the world back. the world is broken. i am the only thing whole.
